ui_bugs.issue: BLACK CANVAS on initial studio mount — image URL loads OK (200) and image.onload should fire but canvas stayed empty until a window-resize (or my fix) forced c.width/c.height re-assignment. Root cause: useLayoutEffect resize runs once on mount with empty deps; if wrapper layout races the initial paint, canvas backing store is out of sync with viewRef.scale/offset computed later in fitView(). Removing crossOrigin (per audit V2 fix note) did NOT resolve this. Applied minimal in-scope fix in /app/frontend/src/components/AnnotationWorkspace.js — inside image.onload, re-apply c.width=wrap.clientWidth, c.height=wrap.clientHeight, then setImgLoaded(true) + fitView(). Verified both 0001 (landscape, 1.5MP) and 0169 (portrait, 12MP) now render with correct aspect.

rca of the issue: Black-canvas bug root cause: useLayoutEffect that sets canvas.width/height depends on `[]` — it runs exactly once on mount. Under certain layout timing, the initial canvas backing store dimensions are stale relative to the wrapper's clientWidth by the time image.onload fires and fitView() computes scale/offset from wrapper. Any subsequent resize event fires the handler which re-syncs c.width/c.height and setTick — resurrecting the draw. Removing crossOrigin (the audit V2 claim) does not affect this race. Fix: re-apply c.width=wrap.clientWidth inside image.onload before setImgLoaded(true)+fitView().
